title: Lousy
text:
Lousy. The first shipment had broken welds and crooked assembly. The second had no broken welds but was still crooked so that two shelves did not fit in the mounts properly, but they were serviceable. If you are mounting this thing in a surface with no studs, the wall anchors DO NOT WORK. These are the most pathetic anchors I have even seen. They have no flange on the back AND they have nothing that digs into the drywall, so as you twist the screws, the anchor turns freely and push through the wall. I had to run to Lowe's for proper anchors.

In case you are now wondering why I even purchased this, it' because it was the only spice rack I could find that has the storage I want.
